source.note: Official main merge commit e75820791e862c2605c2ff169720b6189ed9a109 (PR #127: UI surface detach, original-target/per-call cancellation, per-request stdio response validation and durable effect reconciliation), on top of 02a11ac5a566eab4afe15e5562240fdd11f5c9a4 (PR #126: a continuation claim is given back when the session changes while the App is asked), 0a0dfdfa507f463efdce14611dcbfbf1506ac5d2 (PR #125, review follow-ups to result return), e0625b62e349f49b31d70adcd631e885683c9724 (PR #124, result return), 3825662d16e04f8f1163bb840f2ce1eefc3d6d43 (PR #123 memory import retry and per-scope list cache) and 188d9f6ce33b26905494fc57508d10b8015af857 (PR #122, whose packages/sdk tree equals the previous source 4a4d1d3c); no vendor patch and no dirty files.

steps: Check out main merge commit e75820791e862c2605c2ff169720b6189ed9a109 in two independent directories.
In each: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts (existing store); pnpm build; pnpm -C packages/sdk pack --pack-destination <isolated-directory>.
The two archives are byte-identical; this file is one of them.

On the PR head 9b0130a5 (same tree as the merge): tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json, node scripts/public-api.mjs, node scripts/quality-ratchet.mjs, node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs, node --test scripts/quality-gates.test.mjs and node scripts/clean-consumer.mjs pass; every non-live SDK test plus the stable live selection and surface detach/target live suites (265+ files) pass. Upstream CI did not run its steps (main fails the same way), so it is not claimed green.
Molis Work installs this archive through horizontal/agent-host's file: dependency; the lockfile records the same integrity.
build.note: Built for Batch 39 (user-approved upstream PR #127 merged to molis-prologue main). It replaces the Batch 32 official main build 02a11ac5, recorded in patch-history.json.
